title: AURA-VERIFIER — Independent CLI and Browser Verifier (v1.2.2)
description: Open-source CLI and browser verifier for AURA evidence packages, operationally independent of AUTHENTICA. Version 1.2.2 handles public-key PEM decoding failures in both engines without discarding other completed checks, including asset integrity. It identifies JSON parsing errors through a typed API exception with a stable code and input field; verify --json reports these errors as input_error with exit code 2, without claiming that verification ran. The integrator guide documents this contract. Supported manifest versions remain exactly 1.0 and 1.1. Ed25519 signatures, SHA3-256 exact-byte integrity, RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization, supplied issuer registry checks and optional detached RFC 3161 timestamp verification remain in scope. Signature validity, file integrity and supplied key status are reported separately; identity, authority, ownership, registry authenticity and freshness, historical validity and qualified eIDAS timestamp status are not established. Tests cover both engines, CLI errors, and Chromium, Firefox and Playwright WebKit. This is not external audit certification. Frozen schemas, signed evidence and historical archives remain unchanged.
